observations.finding: Canonical source explicitly preserves requested landscape; the reference lock requires recomposition of portrait footage into landscape and T04 requires landscape aspect ratios. Reviewed archived T55/T58 general portrait/landscape layout wording does not override this.
observations.disposition: Choosing canonical landscape in the forward plan resolves the recorded conflict without inventing portrait shipping approval. Current 3fad configuration discrepancy must remain an implementation gap until repaired/tested; no runtime edit is approved by this review.

observations.finding: DEVICE_LAYOUT_MATRIX labels phone_16_9 but gives [2400,1080], identical to phone_20_9. That ratio is20:9.
observations.disposition: A narrowly scoped correction to [1920,1080] and a focused label/ratio check are justified. Keep state identity and other device obligations; tolerate real tablet4:3 dimension rounding (2732x2048) and preserve physical native4K certification separation.

observations.finding: Baseline resource_actor_contract.validate_schema does not resolve every resource animation reference; T23_FREEZE_REQUIRED in production-ready metal/fuel is not one of placeholder_tokens. It currently misses known unresolved future survivor profiles.
observations.disposition: A dependency-aware cross-reference repair must expose unresolved ownership without making the earlier resource producer depend on T23. Missing or wrong ready profile/actor references must fail when applicable; schema validation remains distinct from animation/runtime proof.
